achievements.name: Not Lycan This...
achievements.description: Story: survive the opening Lycan attack in the village.

achievements.name: Four Lords
achievements.description: Story: reach the ceremony where Mother Miranda and the four Lords appear.

achievements.name: That Sucked!
achievements.description: Boss: defeat Lady Dimitrescu (Castle Dimitrescu).

achievements.name: Got No Strings
achievements.description: Boss: escape House Beneviento by overcoming Donna Beneviento and the doll Angie.

achievements.name: Fish Out of Water
achievements.description: Boss: defeat Salvatore Moreau (the Reservoir).

achievements.name: Up Urs!
achievements.description: Mini-boss: defeat the giant Lycan Uriaș at the Stronghold.

achievements.name: Temporary Measures
achievements.description: Story: place the Giant's Chalice at the ceremony site (Stronghold).

achievements.name: Iron Giant Down
achievements.description: Boss: defeat Karl Heisenberg (the Factory).

achievements.name: The Root of the Matter
achievements.description: Story: reach the game's final confrontation.

achievements.name: Great Dad
achievements.description: Finish the story on at least Casual difficulty.

achievements.name: Best Dad Ever
achievements.description: Finish the story on at least Standard difficulty.

achievements.name: World's Best Dad
achievements.description: Finish the story on at least Hardcore difficulty.

achievements.name: Universe's Best Dad
achievements.description: Finish the story on the Village of Shadows difficulty.

achievements.name: Crafter
achievements.description: Craft an item in the Crafting menu.

achievements.name: Patron
achievements.description: Purchase something from the Duke in the story.

achievements.name: Petty Thief
achievements.description: Unlock a simple lock with a lockpick.

achievements.name: Repairer
achievements.description: Combine a treasure into its complete form.

achievements.name: Hunter
achievements.description: Hunt an animal during the story.

achievements.name: Get the Ball Rolling
achievements.description: Solve a Labyrinth.

achievements.name: Goooaaal!
achievements.description: In the prologue, move the ball from the Winters' bedroom into the study.

achievements.name: Squawk Shot
achievements.description: Shoot down five flying crows in the story.

achievements.name: When You Gotta Go...
achievements.description: Open the door to every outhouse in the village in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Hooligan
achievements.description: Break every breakable window in Castle Dimitrescu in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Quit Hanging Around
achievements.description: Shoot down a Soldat hanging from the production line in the Factory.

achievements.name: Push Comes to Shove
achievements.description: Push away an enemy after guarding in the story.

achievements.name: Trick Shot
achievements.description: Defeat an enemy from long range with the sniper rifle in the story.

achievements.name: Strategist
achievements.description: Defeat at least three enemies with one attack in the story.

achievements.name: Medium Rare
achievements.description: Set fire to a Moroaică in the story.

achievements.name: Fast Reflexes
achievements.description: Knock a flaming arrow out of the sky with a close combat weapon in the story.

achievements.name: Leader of the Pack
achievements.description: Take down the Vârcolac Alfa in the story.

achievements.name: Timber
achievements.description: Defeat Uriaș during the very first Lycan ambush on entering the village (realistically needs a strong New Game+ weapon).

achievements.name: Photographer
achievements.description: Use Photo Mode.

achievements.name: Lucky Number 7
achievements.description: Have 777, 7,777, or 77,777 Lei in your possession in the story.

achievements.name: Mapmatician
achievements.description: Complete the village map.

achievements.name: Cynic
achievements.description: Destroy a Goat of Warding.

achievements.name: Heretic
achievements.description: Destroy all the Goats of Warding.

achievements.name: Gunsmith
achievements.description: Equip a gun with a customizable part.

achievements.name: Veteran Gunsmith
achievements.description: Equip every gun with their customizable parts in the story.

achievements.name: Tinkerer
achievements.description: Create every type of item available in the Crafting menu.

achievements.name: Artisan
achievements.description: Collect every crafting recipe.

achievements.name: Bookworm
achievements.description: Read every single file in the story.

achievements.name: Don't Trust That Snake Oil
achievements.description: Finish the story using four or fewer recovery items.

achievements.name: Dashing Dad
achievements.description: Finish the story within 3 hours.

achievements.name: Frugal Father
achievements.description: Finish the story without spending more than 10,000 Lei.

achievements.name: Knives Out
achievements.description: Finish the story using only the knife (excluding mandatory boss sections).

achievements.name: Combo King
achievements.description: Get a combo of at least 30 during The Mercenaries.

achievements.name: Legendary Cowboy
achievements.description: Achieve at least an S Rank on all stages in The Mercenaries.

achievements.name: Doll Collector
achievements.description: View all character and weapon models.

achievements.name: Art Collector
achievements.description: View all concept art.

achievements.name: Green Teen
achievements.description: Finish Shadows of Rose on at least Casual difficulty.

achievements.name: Serene Teen
achievements.description: Finish Shadows of Rose on at least Standard difficulty.

achievements.name: Supreme Teen
achievements.description: Finish Shadows of Rose on Hardcore difficulty.

achievements.name: It's Starting to Grow on Me
achievements.description: Shadows of Rose (DLC): use Rose's mutamycete power at least 20 times.

achievements.name: Craftsmaster
achievements.description: Craft every type of item in Shadows of Rose.

achievements.name: Village of Blood
achievements.description: Complete the Bloody Village in Additional Orders.

achievements.name: River of Blood
achievements.description: Complete the Bloody River in Additional Orders.
